add.k: A Chronicom Hunter posing as a 1931 police officer
st: In season 7, posing as a 1931 policeman, a Chronicom Hunter tries to shoot Quake, is captured, and melts down under questioning.

files.notes: Only on screen in ep 124 (The New Deal). His name is said later, by Abel in ep 126 ('Cain was in their captivity'), so n is staged there and the step leaves the name out.

st: In season 1, Cybertek security chief Mancini guards a package for Ian Quinn on a train, fits its leg on Mike Peterson, and is killed by him.

files.notes: Named on screen by Coulson and Simmons ('our target is Carlo Mancini, the head of security'). Only in T.R.A.C.K.S. (ep 13).

add.k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. guard on Director Mace's staff
st: Cecilio reminds Director Mace of a call with the National Security Advisor, then escorts Yo-Yo to the lab.
In season 4, Cecilio guards Mace's door as Coulson and May arrive, and later keeps Mace on schedule during his tests.

files.notes: Named by Mace in Slingshot ep 2 ('Yes, thank you, Cecilio') and in AoS ep 68 ('Cecilio, go get yourself a coffee'). Slingshot step first, as in the Coulson example file. Last S4 event in BOOM (ep 79).

add.k: A homeless Inhuman whose touch shows a coming death
st: In season 3, Charles, an Inhuman whose touch shows deaths, is taken by Hydra for Hive and dies saving Daisy from Malick.

files.notes: Named on screen ('It's Charlie, right? Well, Charles.'; 'Charles Hinton.'). Only on screen in Spacetime (ep 59). No group: Hydra holds him captive. No tie to his daughter Robin: they share no scene.

add.k: A Framework student in Coulson's history class
st: In season 4, in the Framework, Hydra takes Chris from Coulson's class, and the Patriot frees him from a falling Hydra center.

files.notes: In Coulson's class unnamed in ep 81 (Self Control); named in ep 82 ('Yeah, Chris Adler.'). The school is not named in the dialogue (wiki: Alexander Pierce High School), so Independent. Status Active at the rescue; like everyone in the Framework he is later deleted.

add.k: A shady drug dealer who drums for the Deke Squad
st: In season 7, Cricket tracks down Mack for Deke, drums in the Deke Squad, and is killed by a Sibyl-Bot at the Lighthouse.

files.notes: Named by Deke ('some guy named Cricket'). Only in ep 130. He is not one of the band's secret S.H.I.E.L.D. recruits, so the group is the band itself.

add.k: The Astran leader of the Confederacy
st: In season 5, Crixon refuses Talbot a seat on the Confederacy, so Talbot crushes him and absorbs him into his Gravitonium.

files.notes: Named by Taryan Kasius ('Crixon is often considered the most wise amongst us'). Only in ep 108. Status Deceased from his absorption (wiki DOD); he is finally ended inside Graviton in ep 110 but is not seen there. op is Talbot, the only one who opposes him on screen.

add.k: A gifted man whose voice knocks people out
st: In season 2, Cal frees Angar from Brynmore, and his scream knocks out a field of students, until Coulson takes him down.

files.notes: Named by Coulson ('David A. Angar') and Cal ('Angar'). Only in ep 35; the Slicing Talons are taken in at the end.

add.k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. field agent recruited by May
st: In season 6, Agent Diaz hunts the Shrike with Yo-Yo, survives two gunshot wounds, and leads agents to safety from the Chronicoms.

files.notes: Unnamed in ep 111; first named in ep 114 ('Agent Diaz, you have something for me?'). Shot by Jaco in ep 119 and shot while Izel holds her body in ep 120. Last on screen in ep 123.

add.k: A San Juan politician who likes Bobbi
st: In season 2, Diego gets Bobbi plans of the old San Juan fort, then slips her a note that places Hydra at a theater.

files.notes: Named by Bobbi ('Diego texted me'). In eps 31 and 32. His office or government is never named on screen, so Independent.

add.k: A mercenary on Nathaniel Malick's crew
st: In season 7, mercenary Durant helps Malick take Afterlife and gets Li's blade power, then fails to kill Yo-Yo and is killed by Kora.

files.notes: Named by Malick in Stolen ('Take Durant here'). On screen in eps 133 and 134.

add.k: An Inhuman who tracks other Inhumans for Lash
st: In season 3, Frye tracks down Inhumans for Lash to kill, is caught and questioned by Coulson and Price, and is killed by Lash.

files.notes: Daisy says 'Meet Dwight Frye'; the agents mostly call him Frye. n is the full name, not the batch's 'Dwight'. Only in ep 48. Helping Lash is not a named group, so Independent.

add.k: A super-strong Inhuman on the run with her daughter
st: In season 2, super-strong Eva Belyakov feeds victims to her daughter Katya in Bahrain, until May kills her in a fight.

files.notes: Named by Coulson ('Meet Eva Belyakov'). Only in Melinda (ep 39). Jiaying was once her guide, but only by Jiaying's account, so Independent and no tie to Jiaying.

add.k: A Hydra general hiding in the military
st: In season 5, General Fischer hands Hale the Hydra project with the Confederacy, then bites a cyanide pill as Talbot arrests him.

files.notes: Named by Hale ('From General Fischer'). Only in ep 103, in Hale's past. He is also an Air Force officer (wiki); tm is HYDRA, the group he serves.

st: In season 3, the Russian Prime Minister survives a coup when Hunter and Bobbi save him from Androvich, then lets them walk free.

files.notes: Only on screen in Parting Shot (ep 57). Called 'Prime Minister' through most of it; Ellis calls him 'Dmitri' (subtitle spelling; the wiki spells it Dimitri). His surname Olshenko is never said, so n is the first name only. Group: he speaks of 'three members of my government', and the dialogue names 'the Russian government'; not a group already in the app.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Posing as a police officer, the Hunter asks Daisy to help him check a truck behind the drugstore and draws his gun on her. She spots him in the mirror, beats him and quakes him into the truck, and Deke drives him to the Zephyr.
stages.whoA: Quake, who beats him behind the drugstore
stages.whoB: A Chronicom Hunter who tries to shoot her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Simmons has the captured Hunter tied up and plugs a device into him to overload his systems with junk data. He holds out and taunts the agents, then lets slip the name of the Hunters' target as he shuts himself down and melts.
stages.whoA: The agent who questions him
stages.whoB: A captured Hunter she questions

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Tied up on the Zephyr, the Hunter scorns Enoch for choosing humans over his own kind. Enoch answers that he chose, while the Hunters were only reassigned, and warns Simmons that pushing him harder could kill him.
stages.whoA: A Chronicom who sided with humans
stages.whoB: A Chronicom Hunter who scorns him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Deke distracts the Hunter as he fights Daisy behind the drugstore. Deke then hot-wires the truck and drives the knocked out Chronicom back to the Zephyr.
stages.whoA: The agent who helps catch him
stages.whoB: A Hunter he helps capture

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson's team boards the train to track Mancini's package, with Mancini as their target. When the team is exposed, Mancini's men knock Coulson and Ward out with a sedative and leave them behind.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent tracking his package
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, his target

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mancini catches Ward trying to warn Simmons that the team has been made. He and his men chase Ward and Coulson off the train and knock them out with a sedative.
stages.whoA: An agent he chases off the train
stages.whoB: The security chief who chases him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mancini and Quinn catch Skye in Quinn's basement as she tries to free Mike Peterson. Mancini takes her Night-Night gun, and she watches as he fits the new leg.
stages.whoA: Skye, whom he catches at gunpoint
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, who catches her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mancini opens the package and fits the Cybertek leg onto Mike's stump, proud as it works. Then Mike tells him the Clairvoyant is unhappy, throws him out a window and kills his whole team.
stages.whoA: The man he fits with a new leg, who kills him
stages.whoB: The security chief who fits his leg

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mancini delivers Cybertek's package to Quinn's villa and helps him hold Skye at gunpoint. Quinn thanks him for his work and sends his team to wait for their pay.
stages.whoA: The buyer of his package
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, who delivers his package

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Cecilio interrupts Director Mace's talk with Yo-Yo to remind him of his call with the National Security Advisor. Mace thanks him and asks him to escort Yo-Yo to the lab.
stages.whoA: Director Mace, his boss
stages.whoB: A guard on his staff

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Cecilio guards Mace's office and announces Coulson and May, and Mace sends him off for a coffee. Later he reminds the Director that he has to stay on schedule during his tests.
stages.whoA: Director Mace, his boss
stages.whoB: A guard who keeps him on schedule

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Mace asks Cecilio to escort Yo-Yo to the lab, where Fitz and Simmons will finish her registration. She thanks Mace and tells Cecilio to lead the way.
stages.whoA: Yo-Yo, whom he escorts to the lab
stages.whoB: A guard who escorts her to the lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Daisy tries to save Charles as Hydra pulls him away, and his touch gives her a vision. On the roof he saves her from Malick at the cost of his life, and she promises to protect his daughter, Robin.
stages.whoA: Daisy, who promises to protect his daughter
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who gives his life to save her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Hydra holds Charles at Malick's dinner with Hive and at Transia. On the roof he touches Malick to stop him killing Daisy, showing him his death, and Malick crushes his throat.
stages.whoA: The Hydra leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A captive Inhuman who shows him his death

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Hydra brings Charles to Hive, who forces him to show Rowan Hamilton a vision of his workers' deaths. Hive then makes the vision come true and plans to keep Charles for his army.
stages.whoA: Hive, who uses his power
stages.whoB: A captive Inhuman whose power he uses

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: In the Framework, Hydra agents pull Chris out of Coulson's history class for tests, and Coulson reminds him to take his bag. Later Coulson spots him in a Hydra center and insists on saving him.
stages.whoA: Mr. Coulson, his teacher
stages.whoB: A student taken from his class

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: As the Hydra center comes down, the Patriot follows Coulson inside to save Chris. May finds him holding the rubble off the boy so he can get away.
stages.whoA: The Patriot, who saves him
stages.whoB: A student he saves from the rubble

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Stranded in the 1980s, Deke hires Cricket to find Mack, then makes him the drummer of his band. Deke thinks he sells soft drinks, but he deals drugs, and a Sibyl-Bot kills him at the Lighthouse.
stages.whoA: Deke, who leads his band
stages.whoB: The shady drummer in his band

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Talbot comes to the Confederacy with Qovas to rewrite Hydra's deal and take a seat. Crixon refuses to let a human join, and Talbot, saying he is no longer human, crushes and absorbs him.
stages.whoA: A human with Gravitonium powers who kills him
stages.whoB: The Confederacy leader he absorbs

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Cal frees Angar from Brynmore and wins his team over with the story of his lost daughter. At the school, Cal has his mask taken off and hands him the microphone to scream at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Cal, who leads his team
stages.whoB: A recruit with a deadly scream

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson briefs the team on Angar's voice and how it shuts down the nervous system. On the school field, before Angar can scream at the agents, Coulson knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The Director who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A gifted man he takes down

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Yo-Yo and Keller bring Diaz along to catch the Shrike loose in the Lighthouse. Later they guard the Shrike hosts on the Zephyr, where Yo-Yo hands her an axe and catches a spike that nearly kills her.
stages.whoA: Yo-Yo, who saves her from a spike
stages.whoB: An agent she fights the Shrike with

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Director Mackenzie puts Diaz at the controls on the Zephyr and comforts her after Jaco shoots her. When May kills Sarge, Diaz reports to Mack and is set to guard May.
stages.whoA: Director Mackenzie, her boss
stages.whoB: An agent who flies the Zephyr for him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: May recruited Diaz into S.H.I.E.L.D., and they fly out on the Zephyr together to bring in a Shrike host. After May shoots Sarge, Diaz guards her, then wakes up shot with no memory of how.
stages.whoA: The agent who recruited her
stages.whoB: An agent she recruited

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Bobbi's politician contact in San Juan gets her the fort's plans and keeps the police away, but will not go down into the garrison. Later he arrives early in a suit and slips her a note placing Hydra at the theater.
stages.whoA: Bobbi, his contact in S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: Her politician contact in San Juan

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Guarding the captured Inhumans, Durant throws a blade at Yo-Yo, who catches it and stabs his leg. Locked up at the Lighthouse, he slips out and tries to cut her throat, but she stops him again.
stages.whoA: Yo-Yo, who beats him twice
stages.whoB: A mercenary who tries to kill her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mack knocks Durant out after Yo-Yo stabs him at Afterlife and brings him back as a prisoner. At the Lighthouse, Mack and Yo-Yo lock him in a cell.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A mercenary he takes prisoner

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Durant marches Coulson through Afterlife at gunpoint as Malick taunts him. Later Coulson points to him as the kind of hitman Malick really saves, just before Kora kills him.
stages.whoA: A prisoner he holds at gunpoint
stages.whoB: A mercenary who guards him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Durant is with Malick as Garrett sees his future in the Time Stream, and shows off his new blade power for him. He holds Coulson at gunpoint while Garrett gets Gordon's power.
stages.whoA: A fellow member of Malick's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow member of Malick's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Lash gives Frye the names of Inhumans, and Frye tracks them down for him to kill. When Frye is taken in, Lash tears open the van, drags him onto the road and kills him.
stages.whoA: Lash, who uses him and then kills him
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who tracks targets for him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Daisy finds Frye hiding in a closet during the raid on his home, and her powers make his rash and headaches flare. She rides with him in the van when Lash attacks.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman agent who brings him in
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who tracks targets for Lash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson questions Frye about Lash and pushes him back down with his hand when he tries to run. Frye tells him that Lash is showing Inhumans mercy.
stages.whoA: The agent who questions him
stages.whoB: Lash's tracker, whom he questions

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Price and Coulson question Frye about how he knew Lash's victims. Price has him moved to an ATCU facility, and Lash kills him on the way.
stages.whoA: The ATCU chief who questions him
stages.whoB: Lash's tracker, whom she questions

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Eva puts her daughter Katya through Terrigenesis and then feeds her victims to keep her going. In Bahrain, Katya watches from hiding as May kills her mother.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, Katya
stages.whoB: Her mother, Eva

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: May goes in alone to bring out the agents held in Bahrain and faces Eva. After a hard fight, May kills her with a broken lamp pole.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills her
stages.whoB: A super-strong woman she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson is brought in to make S.H.I.E.L.D.'s approach to Eva in Bahrain, and offers her S.H.I.E.L.D.'s protection. She tells him all she wants is pain.
stages.whoA: The agent who tries to bring her in
stages.whoB: A gifted woman he tries to bring in

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: As Hydra falls, Fischer warns Hale that S.H.I.E.L.D. has Malick and gives her the device in his vault. He tells her about the Confederacy and makes her the head of the project.
stages.whoA: Hale, the general he hands the project
stages.whoB: The Hydra general who hands her the project

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Talbot comes with soldiers to arrest Fischer as a Hydra traitor. Fischer shouts Hail Hydra and bites a cyanide pill.
stages.whoA: The general who comes to arrest him
stages.whoB: A Hydra traitor he comes to arrest

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: When a fight breaks out at the Siberian site, Hunter pulls the Prime Minister clear and shoots an official who tries to kill him. Later the Prime Minister accuses him of being S.H.I.E.L.D., but lets him walk free.
stages.whoA: The man who saves his life in Siberia
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister he saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: When Androvich's shadow comes for the Prime Minister and Hunter, Bobbi shoots the general and is arrested. The Prime Minister insists she is S.H.I.E.L.D., but in the end lets her go.
stages.whoA: The woman who kills Androvich to save him
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister she saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson orders his team to protect the Prime Minister from Androvich. Later, posing as an ATCU advisor, he tells him that his own Minister of Defense, General Androvich, was trying to assassinate him.
stages.whoA: An ATCU advisor who explains the coup
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister his team protects

dropped.why: Her name is never said or shown on screen: in her five episodes (5x11 to 5x18) Hale never calls her by name, and 'Lee' appears only as a speaker label in the closed captions (s05e13, s05e17 subtitle scripts), so she is named only in the credits.

Her name is never said or shown on screen in Window of Opportunity (6x02): no one calls her by name, and 'DANA' appears only as a speaker label in the closed captions, so she is named only in the credits.

Her name is never said or shown on screen in World's End (4x22) or Rewind (5x05): no one calls her Evans or Lieutenant, and 'Evans' appears only as a speaker label in the closed captions, so she is named only in the credits.

changes.why: No hero faces Crixon on screen; the one who opposes him is Talbot, who demands a seat on the Confederacy, is refused by Crixon, and crushes and absorbs him.
Talbot (app id st-glenn-talbot) is the only one who opposes Crixon on screen; Quake never meets him.

changes.was: Named by Taryan Kasius ('Crixon is often considered the most wise amongst us'). Only in ep 108. Status Deceased from his absorption (wiki DOD); he is finally ended inside Graviton in ep 110 but is not seen there. No hero faces him on screen; op Quake as the hero who opposes the Confederacy and destroys Graviton, uncertain.
changes.now: Named by Taryan Kasius ('Crixon is often considered the most wise amongst us'). Only in ep 108. Status Deceased from his absorption (wiki DOD); he is finally ended inside Graviton in ep 110 but is not seen there. op is Talbot, the only one who opposes him on screen.
changes.why: Notes followed the old guessed op.

changes.was: Coulson leads the team that follows Eva to Bahrain to bring her in, and offers her S.H.I.E.L.D.'s protection. She tells him all she wants is pain.
changes.now: Coulson is brought in to make S.H.I.E.L.D.'s approach to Eva in Bahrain, and offers her S.H.I.E.L.D.'s protection. She tells him all she wants is pain.
changes.why: Coulson does not lead the team: Agent Hart's team tracks her, and 'Agents Coulson and May have been brought in to advise and make the approach.'

changes.was: Dropped: never named on screen, only 'Prime Minister'.
changes.why: President Ellis calls him by name twice in Parting Shot: 'What I know, Dmitri, is that there was an attempt on your life' and 'You satisfied, Dmitri?'
Named on screen, has lines and a part in the plot.

changes.now: Ties to Lance Hunter, Bobbi Morse, Phil Coulson
changes.why: He shares the rescue and the Interpol release with them on screen.
